passed_checks: The root DOI agrees with the citation and latest-version DOI.

The stated total of ten files agrees with the ten resources in the release file collection.

issues_detected.description: Consent, vulnerable-population safeguards and compensation are not documented. Empty caller context keeps these items scored despite the record's non-human-subject declaration; these deductions do not establish ethical misconduct.
issues_detected.recommendation: Clarify applicable donor-source consent and safeguards, and explicitly describe whether participant recruitment, withdrawal or compensation processes occur for this dataset.

issues_detected.description: The record distinguishes project-wide numerical totals from release-specific coverage, but does not provide current-release instance or sample counts. Archive and feature counts do not fill that gap.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide release-specific counts with explicit units and modality/condition scope, distinguishing cells, images, biological samples, features and files.

issues_detected.description: Historical laboratory and biological-source descriptions do not trace the current release's files to raw inputs and derivations. Several external dataset entries also lack their target URLs.
issues_detected.recommendation: Connect current-release outputs to stable raw-source identifiers and documented derivation steps, retaining exact external source links.

issues_detected.description: The preprocessing entry documents FAIRSCAPE packaging and metadata registration, not transformations of measurements. FAIRSCAPE has excluded software role (c); MuSIC has excluded role (e) because its computed cell maps are absent from the release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the measurement-processing, cleaning and annotation steps actually used, and name the software that produced or transformed the released data.

issues_detected.description: Release limitations and source discrepancies are documented, but no measurement-anomaly, outlier or data-quality assessment is provided.
issues_detected.recommendation: Report known measurement anomalies and quality findings with their handling, or provide a supported statement that no anomalies were identified.

issues_detected.description: The record contains no explicit sensitive-content declaration or content warnings, including an explicit declaration of absence.
issues_detected.recommendation: State whether sensitive elements or content requiring warnings are present and explain their scope where applicable.

issues_detected.description: The release description includes perturb-seq data, while external links mark perturb-seq as embargoed and the file inventory lists KOLF2 archives. The record explicitly preserves this source conflict, but measurement-data availability remains ambiguous.
issues_detected.recommendation: Clarify which archives contain measurements versus metadata or references and identify the access status of each perturb-seq component.

issues_detected.description: The record reports a project-page date of June 17, 2025 for the June 2026 release and a Dataverse publication date of June 17, 2026. It explicitly chooses the Dataverse date and preserves the discrepancy rather than silently merging them.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the documented source distinction and update the conflicting release-page date when authoritative correction is available.

semantic_insights: All 50 items remain in the denominator because the caller supplied empty applicability context. The record's non-human-subject declaration was considered as evidence but was not converted into an applicability exclusion.
The complete root datasheet was evaluated once. File collections and component entries were considered at their actual paths without creating child scores or inheriting their fields into the parent.
Population characteristics, acquisition methods and concrete historical changes are meaningfully documented in root prose even where dedicated rubric-associated fields are absent.

The record carefully distinguishes project-wide figures, historical methods and current-release metadata; those caveats prevent unsupported promotion of earlier practices into current-release evidence.
Licensing, scientific motivation, funding identifiers, creator attribution, repository access and release history are strong.
Limited population representativeness is explicitly described and satisfies the bias-category criterion without a formal taxonomy label.
Packaging, metadata generation and production of excluded cell maps do not satisfy the registered processing-software threshold.
